messages:
Mohan: Kickoff — ran regional serve-back benchmarks for rwd-llama-13b-int8 on H100 and A100 across us-east/us-west/eu-west. Highlights:
- H100 p50: 14ms (us-east), 22ms (us-west), 27ms (eu-west)
- H100 p95: 65ms (us-east), 120ms (us-west), 140ms (eu-west)
- A100 p50: 22 / 30 / 35 ms
- A100 p95: 140 / 260 / 300 ms
Edge routing change (pop-affinity + proxy multiplexing) correlates with ~2x p95 increase in us-west on H100. Warmup artifacts visible for first 20 requests. Kernel used: fused-attn where supported, fallback aten for older kernels.

Command & quick output:
```
# run: benchmark --model rwd-llama-13b-int8 --regions us-east,us-west,eu-west --gpus H100,A100 --workers 16 --batch 8
RESULTS CSV:
region,gpu,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_per_sec
us-east,H100,14,65,5200
us-west,H100,22,120,4200
eu-west,H100,27,140,3800
us-east,A100,22,140,3600
us-west,A100,30,260,2800
eu-west,A100,35,300,2500
```

Katie: Which kernel builds (fused-attn rev) and cudnn/cu versions? Also were kernels pinned to compute capability? @Mohan

Sam: quick notes — batching policy = auto, max_batch 8, prefer_local_pop=true for this run. Throughput drop in us-west driven by increased p95 caused by proxy multiplexing queuing when cross-pop RTT > 40ms.

Liz: For capacity sizing — if target p95 <= 100ms worldwide, H100 count needed ~2.2x vs present. Estimate: to serve current load at p95<=100ms in us-west we'd need 1.8x H100 allocated (or fall back to route to us-east). Any perf/cost calc? :thinking:

Mohan: Katie — env: fused-attn v0.9.2 (h100-optimized), aten fallback v0.6, CUDA 12.2, cudnn 9.4. We didn't pin compute caps beyond default. Sam right about proxy queuing; we'll try toggling prefer_local_pop=false and rerun canary.
Quality note: int8 quant produced ~0.2% perplexity increase vs fp16; int4 (experimental) had a ~0.8% delta and a small ROUGE drop ~0.4% on our evalset — keep in mind for rollout.
Plan: 1) small canary in us-west with kernel toggle -> fused-disabled, 2) route-pop affinity tweak (prefer_local_pop=false) for 10% traffic, 3) collect p50/p95 + quality drift for 24h, 4) decide scale vs routing.

infra-bot: Canary deployment started by @mohan — canary-id=canary-20240302-11

Liz: Sounds good. For the canary, also log KV-cache hit rates and prefix-cache usage. If p95 doesn't improve after kernel change, we should fallback traffic to us-east rather than scale immediately.

Sam: I'll set up a quick dashboard: p50/p95, qps, tokens/s, kernel-type tag, proxy-queue-latency. ETA 2h.

Mohan: Ack. I'll kick the canary now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
